svg.text: ListDetailPaneScaffold at 840 dp and wider: a 360 dp list pane on the surface, the open

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: conversation in a detail pane drawn as a surface-container-low card. The selected row

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: uses the secondary-container highlight. The handle between panes resizes them.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: The radio control is in the rail’s header, so neither pane owns it; the panes’ top app

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: bars carry only their own actions. The thread keeps its overflow; there is no Back

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: because the list is beside it.
